'Beeku Naik' is a distinctive Telangana surname combination and returned essentially no competing doctors, but as instructed I still required the CARE branch to match explicitly rather than relying on the name. It does: CARE's own domain returned a per-doctor page titled 'Dr. Beeku Naik Ds | Interventional Cardiologist Doctor in Malakpet, Hyderabad | CARE Hospitals' at https://www.carehospitals.com/doctor/hyderabad/malakpet/beeku-naik-ds-interventional-cardiologist , with city (hyderabad), branch (malakpet) and speciality (interventional-cardiologist) all encoded in the URL path, and he also appears on the CARE Malakpet cardiology and cardiac-sciences branch listings. That is name + trailing initials 'Ds' + specialty + hospital + branch + city matching on the hospital's own site - four of the section-2 factors, well above the required two. NOT an index-coverage gap and NOT a stale affiliation: CARE publishes a live per-doctor page for him at the exact branch given in the input row. NEAR-MISS CARDIOLOGISTS REJECTED: searches surfaced several unrelated Hyderabad cardiologists with the same surname - Dr. Uday Kumar Naik / 'Dr Uday Naik's Heart and Diabetic Clinic, Malakpet' (a different man, and note his clinic is also in Malakpet, which makes the address alone a poor discriminator), Dr Sudhir Naik at Apollo, and Prof. Nitish Naik of AIIMS Delhi. None of their pages, clinics or contact details has been used or recorded here. PHONE DISCARDED AFTER EXACT-PHRASE CHECK: search summaries repeatedly asserted '+91-40-68106529' as the way to book him. I had already re-searched that exact string in quotes while researching another CARE doctor and it resolves to CARE Hospitals' own central switchboard, carried on CARE's contact-us pages - it is a hospital booking line, not his own or a dedicated clinic line, and section 4 bars recording it as his. professional_phone is therefore BLANK. No email for him appeared verbatim anywhere and none was constructed from the carehospitals.com domain. NO CONTACT-BROKER SOURCE WAS USED OR CONSULTED. BAND: Medium, not High. Only ONE section-5 official source backs this - carehospitals.com, where the per-doctor page and the several doctor-list pages are all one domain and therefore count once. I spent one query on the government/regulator route recommended by section 4 ('healinindia', NMC, Telangana State Medical Council) specifically to try to lift this row to High, and it returned nothing for him - onlinetsmc.in surfaced as a portal but carried no indexed record for him - so the row honestly stays at Medium. No .ac.in, ORCID or Scholar record surfaced either, and per section 2c I did not spend further searches hunting scholarly identifiers. FOR THE HUMAN: this is a thin row by design of the evidence, not by lack of effort - four well-targeted queries found exactly one source family. He is early-career (7 years) with no ownership signals, so he is a weak prospect for the workbook's high-net-worth purpose even though the identity match itself is solid.
